title: GB200 NVL72 two-tier memory (rack level)

units.gbps_per_gb: GB/s per GB (= TB/s per TB)

conventions: Rack-level (NVL72) figures as printed in NVIDIA's specification table. gbps_per_gb = bandwidth_tbps / capacity_tb (TB/s per TB equals GB/s per GB).

nvidia_gb200_nvl72.cite: NVIDIA, GB200 NVL72 product page, specifications table
nvidia_gb200_nvl72.locator: Specifications table (sparse|dense footnote applies to compute rows only)

rows.attach: on-package, on the Blackwell GPUs (72 GPUs)
rows.loc: Specifications table, GB200 NVL72 column: 'GPU Memory | Bandwidth 13.4 TB HBM3E | 576 TB/s'; 'CPU Memory | Bandwidth 17 TB LPDDR5X | 14 TB/s'
rows.unc: capacity and bandwidth: exact (vendor spec); gbps_per_gb derived: 576/13.4 = 42.99
rows.note: gbps_per_gb tagged D. Cross-check, same table GB200 Superchip column: 372 GB HBM3E at 16 TB/s -> 43.0.

rows.attach: on the Grace CPU module (36 Grace CPUs), coherent over NVLink-C2C to the Blackwell GPUs
rows.loc: Specifications table, GB200 NVL72 column: 'GPU Memory | Bandwidth 13.4 TB HBM3E | 576 TB/s'; 'CPU Memory | Bandwidth 17 TB LPDDR5X | 14 TB/s'
rows.unc: capacity and bandwidth: exact (vendor spec); gbps_per_gb derived: 14/17 = 0.824
rows.note: gbps_per_gb tagged D. Capacity tier by role. The page does not state whether 14 TB/s is peak per direction; treat as vendor peak. Superchip column: 480 GB LPDDR5X at up to 512 GB/s -> 1.07 (differs from rack ratio because 17 TB is rounded and 14 TB/s is rounded: 36x480 GB = 17.3 TB, 36x512 GB/s = 18.4 TB/s, not 14).

extraction.agent_a: extractor A, page text parsed from saved HTML
extraction.method: Fetched NVIDIA page with curl, stripped HTML, read specification table values; arithmetic by hand/python.

cross_check.resolved: n/a; both flag the per-superchip 480 GB @ 512 GB/s vs rack 17 TB @ 14 TB/s inconsistency on the NVIDIA page

caveats: Rack LPDDR5X bandwidth 14 TB/s does not equal 36 x 512 GB/s (=18.4 TB/s); the printed rack figure is used as published. Superchip-level ratio is 1.07, rack-level 0.82; slide uses rack-level.
Page notes compute rows are sparse|dense; memory rows carry no such footnote.
'Behind NVLink-C2C' is the connection to GPUs; the LPDDR5X sits on the Grace module, not on-package with the GPU.
